items.title: Seven equivalent Carlitz ghost-image and Frobenius-lift criteria
items.author: Darij Grinberg
items.source_version: Official author draft version1.4, source, last-update 2026-08-10 (CC0 1.0)
items.difficulty_reason: The author proves the seven-condition ghost-image criterion on q-nests for F-modules with the three stated Frobenius-lift assumptions, relating congruences, Carlitz/Frobenius expansions and Mobius/totient divisibility. The original generalized ghost criterion, Chinese-remainder and Carlitz-lift arguments and full selected proof are supplied. Other unfinished functor-existence assertions and speculative symmetric-function discussion are context only and are not counted or asserted proved.
